description: Figure 4 is a line plot illustrating Macro-F1 score (%) as a function of the number of tokens used during tokenization training, comparing two conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 48 to 58 with tick labels at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58. Two solid lines with circular markers are shown: a pink line labeled “MATTER (ours)” and a purple line labeled “w/o material information.” The pink MATTER line starts near 55 at 0.5, dips slightly around 0.6–0.7 (about 54–55), rises to around 57 near 0.8, reaches about 58 at 1.0, then declines to roughly 52–53 around 1.2–1.3, rises slightly near 1.4 (around 54), and ends near 51 at 1.5. The purple “w/o material information” line starts around 52–53 at 0.5, increases to about 54 near 0.7, then gradually decreases from roughly 53–54 around 0.8–1.0 to about 52–53 by 1.2–1.3, shows a small uptick near 1.4 (around 53–54), and drops sharply to about 48 at 1.5.
